infer: means and variances¶

Tests of means (one sample, paired, two samples), of a mean with known spread, and of variances. Each page documents one function: its signature, what it computes, the parameters, the fields of the result, the errors, and examples with their output.

The Surface¶

Function

What it does

ttest

One-sample Student t-test of a mean.

ttest_paired

Paired-sample t-test: is the mean difference of matched pairs zero?

ttest2

Two-sample t-test for the means of two independent samples, pooled or Welch.

ztest

One-sample z-test of a mean when the standard deviation is known.

vartest

Chi-squared test of one variance against a stated value.

vartest2

F test for the equality of two variances.

f_ratio

The F test for two variances, under its other name.
